pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark patches with medium-contrast edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck are larger and more elongated, while patches on the mid-to-lower flank are smaller and more densely clustered.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a mesh-like topology. Junction nodes predominantly show tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, maintaining structural continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-profile, high-frequency serrated line is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, creating a distinct textural boundary against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: A pair of spiraled, vertical structures are positioned immediately behind the giraffe's upper back/lower neck, creating a visual protrusion from the dorsal silhouette due to a background object.
